plugins.description: Brand, content and campaign skills for the Daxko marketing team. Currently ships Agent 9 — Brand Guardian, which reviews draft marketing content against Daxko's official brand guidelines and returns a verdict, a six-part scorecard, every violation tied to the rule it breaks, and a corrected rewrite. It reviews content; it does not write it.
